# Memmy v1.2.6

## Highlights

- Fixed repeated escaping in Windows launch-at-login commands and repaired legacy entries while preserving disabled startup preferences.
- Improved Memory management responsiveness, filtered browsing, detail loading, and recovery from temporary read failures.
- Improved background processing fairness, retry scheduling, scan recovery, and responsiveness to new real-time tasks.

## Memory improvements

- Added per-turn task and feedback judgment and expanded capture summaries to 300 characters.
- Preserved historical memory relationships during turn migration and deduplicated recalled sources.
- Strengthened project boundaries and retained deleted world-model fields across scans and imports.
- Preserved owner boundaries for nonlocal memory reads and deletes, including task data and linked records.
- Applied namespace authorization to recall evidence and linked details, including searches that reuse a query ID across scopes.
- Isolated panel caches from business storage and reduced pending-work configuration checks.
- Strengthened multilingual Skill verification, tool-name extraction and source evidence validation, with persisted attempts and retry backoff.
- Restored real-time capture from chunked Cursor histories, excluded simulated background completions, and supported older Hermes databases without a working-directory column.
- Repaired DSH plugin registration and malformed configuration while preserving supported legacy installations.

## Agent and Desktop improvements

- Preserved Computer Use authorization through eligible Goal continuations.
- Improved Markdown, LaTeX, generated-file links, and attachment handling; reasoning paths use display-only inline code.
- Hide the Knowledge sidebar while the service is unavailable.
- Corrected Windows startup status when multiple entries share the same launcher command.
- Released PDF preview workers when previews close, fail, or switch documents.
- Included the approved v1.2.6 source updates for CJK PDF and Office rendering, managed TeX, plugin localization, recording playback and transcription, and literature-review recovery.

## Upgrade notes

- Memmy Desktop and Agent use version `1.2.6`. The Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned at `2.1.7`.
- Existing malformed Windows startup entries are repaired when the updated desktop app is opened. Disabled or absent startup entries are not enabled by this repair.
- Nonlocal reads and deletes of device-owned Memory records require a configured user identity and a matching captured namespace; cross-profile/workspace reads of those records return 404. Local desktop management retains device-wide access.
- Direct Skills aggregated from shared or unproven namespaces remain available to local management; nonlocal reads and deletes remain denied until their namespace provenance is established.
- Installation, in-place upgrade, signed-package validation, and publication remain separate release checks.
- Release validation records the approved source and candidate commits and checks source inclusion and remote freshness before and after regression.
